$comment: Schema for the DDR3 memory controller verification plan (vplan). One vplan item = one verifiable requirement traceable to the microarchitecture spec.

item_fields.id: Stable vplan ID, VP_<SCOPE>_<NNN>. Never renumbered once assigned.
item_fields.title: One-line human-readable requirement name.
item_fields.scope: Validation scope this belongs to (matches spec.validation_scopes).
item_fields.requirement: What must be true. Written as an assertion about behavior, not about the testbench.
item_fields.spec_ref: Dotted path into llmmc_microarchitecturespec_filled.json that this requirement is derived from.
item_fields.failure_ref: Optional failure_taxonomy category ID this requirement guards against (e.g. TIMING_001).
item_fields.method: assertion | directed | random | formal — how this requirement is proven.
item_fields.coverage_items: List of coverage objects that measure whether this requirement was exercised.
item_fields.priority: critical | major | minor — inherited from failure_taxonomy severity where applicable.
item_fields.waiver_reason: Required when status == waived. Must name who approved it.
item_fields.tests: List of test/sequence names that target this item. Populated by the run flow, not by hand.

coverage_item_fields.name: Covergroup.coverpoint path for functional, or RTL scope for code coverage.

status_rules: An item may only reach 'covered' when every coverage_item meets its goal AND its method has been executed.
'waived' requires waiver_reason naming an approver. Waivers are reviewed at each milestone.
Items are never marked covered by a passing test alone — coverage must confirm the scenario was exercised.
